transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As you know, Line 6 is scheduled to produce 1,400 medical-device housings this week, but R-17 resin is temporarily unavailable. We have R-22 available as an alternate medical-grade resin for a controlled run. Before I issue the engineering authorization for this change, I need to hear from each of you on any constraints. Quality, process engineering, regulatory affairs, and production planning — please share any concerns or requirements you have so we can proceed properly through change-control. What do we need to address?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical quality constraint. I checked the customer's revised control plan this morning, and it requires dimensional and tensile testing on exactly 50 first-off housings — all 50 must pass before the alternate-resin run can be released. It also requires retention of exactly 10 samples. One more issue: the revised control plan has not yet been attached to the change-control record, so we need to get that documented before authorization.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a critical process constraint to share. My process trial on R-22 showed that it must be dried at 80 degrees Celsius for exactly 4 hours and requires a 45-minute screw purge before molding. I recorded this in my engineering notebook but have not yet entered it into the production setup sheet, so we need to make sure these parameters are formally documented before production begins.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a regulatory constraint to raise. I confirmed with the resin manufacturer that the medical-grade declaration for R-22 applies only to supplier lot L2407-18. Our regulatory procedure requires lot-specific traceability and customer notification before any housings made from that lot can be shipped. Additionally, the supplier confirmation is currently only in my email and has not yet been placed in the release file, so we need to get that formally documented as part of the change-control record before authorization.
